resources.string:
This app reads vehicle telemetry such as speed, gear, EV battery state, pedal position, and turn signals.

It never writes to any vehicle property.

Data leaves the car only over a local network connection to your Raspberry Pi driver display.
Live property data is hidden while the vehicle is in motion.\n\nShift to Park (P) or apply the parking brake to view.
Notifies you that the EX30 Companion is forwarding vehicle telemetry to your Raspberry Pi driver display.
Forwarding vehicle telemetry to Pi driver display
